title: Business Development Executive -SM
description:
Job Description - Business Development Executive
Location: Belapur, Navi Mumbai 
Experience: 5+ Years 
Employment Type: Full-Time About the Company Epitome Research and Business Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a boutique market research and brand solutions company established in 2016, with a presence in India and the UK. The company specialises in delivering customised research solutions, market intelligence, and actionable business insights to help clients make informed business decisions. Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Business Development Executive with a strong background in Quantitative Market Research. The ideal candidate should have proven experience in business development, outbound calling, client acquisition, and selling customised market research solutions. The candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, generating leads, acquiring clients, and managing the complete sales cycle. The role requires a strong understanding of Quantitative Market Research, particularly Online Panel and Data Collection services, along with the ability to develop long-term client relationships and achieve revenue targets. Key Responsibilities 1. Identify potential clients, target industries, and new business opportunities within the market research industry.
2. Generate qualified leads through outbound calling, cold calling, email campaigns, networking, and other business development activities.
3. Acquire new clients and develop strong, long-term business relationships.
4. Manage the complete sales cycle, including prospecting, lead generation, requirement understanding, proposal submission, negotiation, and deal closure.
5. Promote and sell customised Quantitative Market Research solutions to prospective clients.
6. Develop business opportunities in Online Panel, Data Collection, and other quantitative research services.
7. Understand client research requirements and coordinate with internal teams to propose suitable research solutions.
8. Prepare and present business proposals, quotations, commercial presentations, and service offerings.
9. Conduct regular follow-ups with prospective clients, negotiate commercial terms, and convert opportunities into business.
10. Achieve assigned business development, client acquisition, and revenue targets.
11. Coordinate with internal research and operations teams to ensure smooth project execution and client satisfaction.
12. Maintain relationships with existing clients and identify opportunities for repeat business and account growth. Mandatory Skills Requirements
- Minimum 5+ years of experience in Sales and Business Development.
- Prior experience in the Market Research industry is mandatory.
- Strong hands-on experience in Quantitative Market Research.
- Proven experience in selling customised market research solutions.
- Hands-on experience in outbound calling and cold calling is mandatory.
- Strong understanding of Online Panel and Data Collection services.
- Proven track record in client acquisition and new business development.
- Experience in managing the complete end-to-end sales cycle.
- Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to identify business opportunities, generate leads, and achieve revenue targets. Important Screening Criteria - Candidates must have prior experience in the Market Research industry.
- Quantitative Market Research experience is mandatory.
- Hands-on outbound calling experience is compulsory.
- Experience in customised market research sales is essential.
- Candidates with only Syndicated Research experience will not be considered.
- Candidates without relevant Online Panel and Data Collection exposure will not be preferred.

Role & responsibilities 

 Job Title: Business Development Manager / Senior Manager Mid-Market (B2B Sales) 
 Company: G4S Secure Solutions India Location: Multiple Locations / Pan-India Hubs Experience: 2 – 8 Years Role Type: Full-Time, Individual Contributor 
 About the Role We are looking for high-energy, target-driven Business Development Managers to drive our Mid-Market corporate sales across Pan-India hubs. In this role, you will focus on acquiring new mid-sized corporate clients and expanding business within existing accounts. You will manage mid-sized commercial deals (ranging from 20 Lakhs to 85 Lakhs+ / 25K–100K in annual contract value), allowing you to focus purely on high-impact corporate accounts while smaller transactional inquiries are handled by our operations team. 
 What’s in It for You? (Compensation & Growth) Monthly Payouts: Fast-paced monthly performance tracking with monthly commission payouts . Multi-Year Earning Potential: Earn trailing commissions in Years 2 and 3 for multi-year contracts you close, plus an Annual Target Bonus. Clear Career Path: High performers hitting targets for 2 consecutive years qualify for fast-track promotion to Enterprise Sales roles. Key Responsibilities 1. New Business Acquisition (50% of your time) Identify and pitch to potential corporate clients across industrial corridors, manufacturing plants, logistics hubs, and commercial buildings through cold calling, field visits, and networking. Follow up on and convert inbound leads from digital marketing, website inquiries, and branch referrals. Prepare accurate pricing proposals/cost sheets using company tools and respond to commercial RFQs while maintaining healthy profit margins. Close multi-year security service contracts within the mid-market segment. 2. Account Expansion & Retention (35% of your time) Build strong relationships with existing mid-market clients to expand manpower deployments across new sites. Cross-sell electronic security solutions (CCTV, access control, and intrusion detection packages) to existing customers. Manage timely contract renewals (targeting 90%+ retention) and execute annual price revisions aligned with statutory minimum wage updates. 3. Sales Operations & Smooth Handover (15% of your time) Maintain up-to-date pipeline data, meeting notes, and deal stages in Salesforce (CRM) . Coordinate closely with Branch Operations and Finance teams after contract signing to ensure smooth deployment and timely billing. 
 Who We Are Looking For Experience & Education: Education: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline (MBA in Sales/Marketing is a plus). Manager: 2–5 years of proven experience in high-volume B2B / field sales. Senior Manager: 5–8 years of proven B2B / commercial services sales experience. 
 Skills & Competencies: Sales Hustle: Strong track record in B2B field sales, cold calling, lead qualification, and closing deals quickly. Client Relationship Management: Ability to engage and negotiate with Business Owners, Plant Heads, Facility Managers, and Purchase Officers. Commercial Acumen: Comfortable working with pricing/costing sheets, profit margins, and basic labour compliance/minimum wage structures. Tech-Savvy: Hands-on experience using CRM tools (like Salesforce) and MS Excel. (Preferred) Basic understanding of manned guarding or electronic security systems (CCTV, access control).

title: Forward Deployed Engineer Intern
description:
Forward Deployed Engineer Intern Job Summary As a Forward Deployed Engineer Intern at Bynry, youll be embedded with our engineering team, working alongside a mentor and with our QA, DevOps and Customer Success teams. You will listen to how utilities actually use SMART360, build the small integration, automation or AI workflow that solves a real problem, test it, and see it work in a real or customer-like environment. This is hands-on engineering with the customer in view. It is not a sales-demo role, a support-ticket role or a QA-only role. Location Pune, India Duration 6-month internship with immediate start date. Based on performance, the internship is extended by 3 months (up to 9 months in total), when full-time conversion is evaluated. Conversion depends on performance and business need and is not automatic. Responsibilities Observe customer discovery calls and workshops, then take notes, ask clarifying questions and summarise requirements as you grow into the role. Onboard customer feedback to product and engineering, and help turn repeated needs into reusable components. Build small APIs, integrations (REST, webhooks) and automation workflows in Python, with your mentor reviewing your work. Use SQL to query, check and move data for customer solutions. Prototype AI-powered features using LLM APIs and basic retrieval (RAG) workflows, and check the outputs for accuracy. Own end-to-end testing, including functional, integration, regression, and UAT, ensuring product quality and alignment with client requirements. Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve functional issues, configuration gaps, and client-specific challenges independently. Drive quality improvements through test automation, production validation, and continuous feedback to ensure reliable product functionality and successful client deployments. Support deployments using Git, CI/CD and cloud basics (AWS). Help monitor, debug and find the root cause of issues. Document what you build: how it works, how to run it, and how a customer team can use it. Present demos of your work to the team and contribute reusable components. As an intern, you will not be expected to lead customer workshops, own production systems or carry on-call duties alone. Your mentor stays accountable while your ownership grows. What You'll Achieve in 6 Months Ship at least one small solution (an integration, automation or AI workflow) that runs in a real or customer-like environment. Back your work with automated tests that pass regression checks. Explain a customer problem, your solution and the trade-offs in plain language. Document your work so someone else can run and maintain it. Required Skills & Qualifications Degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Working knowledge of Python and related to framework. Understanding of APIs, HTTP and REST. Basic SQL. Git and version control basics. Strong problem-solving and debugging habits. Clear written and verbal communication. Presentation skill is required. Curiosity about customers and their problems, and the habit of finishing what you start. An AI-first mindset: you use AI tools to learn and build faster, and you can explain and verify every line you submit. Preferred Skills Qualifications JavaScript or TypeScript; FastAPI, Django or Node.js and React JS Testing tools such as pytest, Playwright or Postman. Docker, AWS or Google Cloud basics. A project that calls an LLM API, or a GitHub profile with projects you built. Interest in building a career in engineering within a SaaS/tech-driven environment. Candidate with relevant experience (6 months to 1 year) will be highly appreciated

description:
BACS is hiring an experienced, result-oriented Manager Business Development to establish, expand and manage a strong PAN-India Vendor, Manpower Supplier and Recruitment Agency Network supporting our power, energy, engineering and industrial project operations. 
 The selected candidate will be responsible for identifying, evaluating, onboarding and developing Manpower Agencies, Labour Contractors, Recruitment Consultants, Field Sourcing Partners, Staffing Vendors and Industrial Manpower Service Providers . 
 The role requires extensive field networking, face-to-face business meetings, vendor negotiations, manpower sourcing coordination and active engagement with Recruitment, HR and Project Operations Teams. 
 The primary objective is to develop reliable sourcing partners capable of providing skilled, semi-skilled, technical and project-site manpower, ensuring measurable vendor conversion, confirmed manpower availability, timely mobilization and successful deployment. 
 Role & responsibilities 
 1. PAN-India Vendor Network Development 
 Identify and develop new manpower agencies, labour contractors, recruitment consultants and industrial staffing partners across India. Establish vendor networks in major industrial clusters, manpower sourcing markets and project locations. Expand the Company's sourcing presence through direct networking, references, market research and industry contacts. Build a geographically diversified vendor network to support current and upcoming project requirements. 
 2. Field Sourcing & Business Networking 
 Conduct regular field visits to industrial areas, contractor offices, recruitment agencies and manpower sourcing locations. Schedule and conduct face-to-face meetings with prospective vendors, manpower suppliers and business associates. Present BACS company profile, project requirements, sourcing opportunities and commercial expectations. Develop business relationships through continuous field engagement and professional networking. 
 3. Labour Contractor & Staffing Vendor Development 
 Identify labour contractors and staffing vendors experienced in industrial, construction, EPC and renewable energy projects. Assess contractor manpower strength, sourcing capacity, mobilization timelines and operational capabilities. Develop alternative labour sourcing channels for urgent, bulk and project-specific manpower requirements. Coordinate vendor engagement and onboarding according to approved company procedures. 
 4. Vendor Evaluation, Verification & Onboarding 
 Collect vendor profiles, business registration details, relevant experience and manpower supply information. Evaluate vendors based on sourcing capacity, reliability, response time, service quality and commercial suitability. Coordinate vendor documentation, verification and approval with relevant internal departments. Maintain updated vendor registration and onboarding records. 
 5. Manpower Mobilization & Deployment Support 
 Coordinate with Recruitment and Project Operations Teams regarding vendor-sourced candidates and deployment commitments. Monitor joining dates, candidate availability, manpower replacements and mobilization readiness. Follow up with vendors to minimize candidate dropouts and delayed joining. Track vendor-sourced manpower until actual site deployment and confirmation. 
 Required Skills & Competencies 
 Business Development & Vendor Network Expansion Manpower Agency & Labour Contractor Development Industrial Manpower Sourcing Staffing Vendor Identification & Management Field Sourcing & Face-to-Face Business Meetings Vendor Evaluation, Verification & Onboarding Commercial Negotiation & Vendor Agreements Technical, Skilled & Bulk Manpower Sourcing Vendor Lead Generation & Business Conversion Manpower Mobilization & Deployment Coordination Vendor Relationship & Performance Management PAN-India Business Networking Field Team Leadership & Target Management Vendor Database, MS Excel & MIS Reporting Communication, Negotiation & Problem-Solving 
 Preferred candidate profile 
 Graduate / MBA / PGDM from a recognized institution. 5 - 10 years of relevant experience in Business Development, Manpower Sourcing, Staffing Services or Vendor Development. Strong existing network of manpower agencies, labour contractors, recruitment consultants or industrial staffing vendors. Demonstrated experience developing and managing manpower sourcing partners across multiple locations. Practical knowledge of industrial manpower categories, staffing requirements and vendor commercial arrangements. Experience conducting field visits, face-to-face vendor meetings and commercial negotiations. Ability to generate qualified vendor leads and convert them into active manpower sourcing partners. Strong communication, relationship management, negotiation, leadership and reporting skills. Proficiency in MS Excel, vendor databases, performance trackers and management reporting. Willingness to undertake frequent field visits and PAN-India business travel.

title: HR Operations & Compliance Executive  Real Estate  Infrastructure
description:
Job Description HR Executive (Operations & Statutory Compliance) 
 Location: Bengaluru, Karnataka
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Experience: 1 to 3 years experience 
 Salary: As per Industry Standards and Experience Industry experience Mandatory : Real estate Gender : only Male Candidates Can appy 
 As we expand our construction and real estate operations, we are looking for a compliance-focused HR professional to manage workforce administration, contractor documentation, and statutory compliance. 
 About the Role 
 The HR Executive will be responsible for managing HR operations and statutory compliance across our corporate office and construction sites. The role requires hands-on experience in PF and ESI filings (including physical filing at Bengaluru offices), BOCW, Karnataka RERA, Q-Farm/Q-Form documentation, and construction labour compliance. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. HR Operations & Employee Management 
 Manage employee onboarding, documentation, and lifecycle management. Maintain employee master data, personnel files, and statutory records. Handle attendance, leave, overtime, shift records, and payroll inputs. Coordinate joining and exit formalities, including Full & Final settlements. Maintain contractor and construction site workforce records. Coordinate manpower requirements with project managers, site engineers, and department heads. 
 2. Payroll & PF Compliance 
 Coordinate monthly payroll, salary structures, deductions, and reimbursements. Handle PF registrations, UAN activation, and employee additions/deletions. Prepare monthly PF ECR filings and challan payments. Handle PF transfers, withdrawals, and claim documentation. Coordinate with EPFO offices in Bengaluru. Mandatory: Practical experience in physical PF filing and office-level coordination in Bengaluru. 
 3. ESI Compliance & Physical Filing 
 Handle ESI registration, insurance number generation, and monthly contributions. Maintain ESI records and coordinate claims and benefits documentation. Liaise with ESIC offices in Bengaluru and submit physical applications wherever required. Mandatory: Hands-on PF and ESI physical filing experience in Bengaluru. 
 4. BOCW Compliance (Construction) 
 Handle BOCW establishment registration and renewals. Coordinate cess calculations, payments, and compliance records. Maintain construction labour registers, contractor details, labour licence records, and contractor agreements. Coordinate with Labour Department officials for registrations and inspections. 
 5. RERA Compliance (Real Estate) 
 Coordinate Karnataka RERA project registration documentation. Maintain project approvals, statutory documents, and compliance records. Coordinate with legal, accounts, and project teams. Track RERA timelines and periodic updates. 
 6. Q-Farm / Q-Form Documentation 
 Prepare and maintain Q-Farm/Q-Form documentation as per construction compliance requirements. Maintain project-wise statutory documentation and track pending items. Maintain physical and digital filing systems. 
 7. Labour Law & Statutory Compliance 
 Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws and Karnataka statutory requirements. Maintain wage, attendance, and leave registers. Support inspections and audits. Monitor statutory renewals, returns, and payments. Prepare monthly HR and compliance reports for management. 
 Mandatory Requirements 
 1-3 years of experience in HR Operations and Statutory Compliance. Experience in the Construction, Real Estate, or Infrastructure industry. Practical PF and ESI physical filing experience in Bengaluru. Experience coordinating with EPFO and ESIC offices. Knowledge of BOCW registration and cess compliance. Working knowledge of Karnataka RERA. Practical experience in Q-Farm/Q-Form documentation. Knowledge of payroll processing and statutory deductions. Knowledge of Karnataka labour laws and statutory registers. Good working knowledge of MS Excel and compliance trackers. 
 Preferred Profile 
 Independently handled PF, ESI, and labour law compliance. Experience in government office liaison in Bengaluru. Experience in construction site labour documentation. Strong follow-up, coordination, and communication skills. Kannada communication skills will be an added advantage. Male Candidates only Apply for this Role from Construction Industry 
 What We Offer 
 Salary as per industry standards and experience. Provident Fund (PF). Casual Leave (CL) and Privilege Leave (PL). Annual performance-based increments.

Job Title: Team Lead - Talent Acquisition (BPO Mass Recruitment) Walk-In Interview - Monday to Friday 11:00 AM - 6:00 PM Department: Human Resources Talent Acquisition Reporting To: Talent Acquisition Manager Experience Required: 2 to 4 years Joining: Immediate joiners preferred 
 Work Location: Movate Technologies, Ground Floor, Ambit IT Park, Chennai 
 Shift Timing: Day Shift (10:00 AM 7:00 PM IST), 6 Days Working 
 Job Summary Senior Executive - Talent Acquisition is responsible for managing end-to-end recruitment activities for bulk and lateral hiring requirements across BPO/ITES operations. The role focuses on sourcing, managing team, screening, interviewing, stakeholder management, offer management, onboarding coordination, and ensuring timely closure of positions while maintaining hiring quality and candidate experience. The incumbent will work closely with Operations, HR, Workforce Management (WFM), Training, and Business Leaders to support workforce ramp-up plans and business growth. 
 Key Responsibilities Recruitment & Sourcing Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from requisition receipt to candidate onboarding. Understand hiring requirements and workforce plans from stakeholders. Source candidates through job portal social media, employee referrals, recruitment vendors, and internal databases. Screen resumes and conduct preliminary interviews to assess candidate suitability. Build and maintain candidate talent pools for ongoing and future staffing requirements. Ensure timely closure of requisitions within agreed hiring SLAs. BPO Mass Recruitment Drive volume hiring for Customer Service, Technical Support, Sales, Collections, Non-Voice, Back Office, Chat Support, Content Moderation, and other BPO functions. Manage large-scale hiring campaigns to support business ramp-ups and expansion plans. Conduct walk-in drives, mega hiring events, virtual drives, campus recruitment programs, and job fairs. Coordinate and manage bulk interview drives with hiring managers and operations teams. Ensure achievement of daily, weekly, and monthly hiring targets. Develop innovative sourcing strategies to attract quality talent in a competitive market. Maintain a continuous talent pipeline to support recurring hiring demands. Stakeholder Management Work closely with Hiring Managers, Operations Leaders, and HR teams to understand hiring priorities. Provide regular recruitment updates and hiring dashboards to stakeholders. Coordinate interview schedules and feedback collection. Manage and resolve recruitment-related escalations. 
 Candidate Experience & Offer Management Ensure a positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment process. Conduct salary discussions and negotiate compensation within approved guidelines. Roll out offers and ensure timely completion of joining formalities. Maintain regular communication with offered candidates to improve joining ratios. Support pre-boarding and onboarding activities. 
 Recruitment Operations & Reporting Maintain recruitment MIS, trackers, and hiring reports. Ensure recruitment process compliance and documentation accuracy. Monitor recruitment metrics and identify areas for process improvement. Support employer branding initiatives and social media recruitment activities. Collaborate with Training and HR teams to ensure seamless onboarding and candidate handover. 
 Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or related discipline. 
 Experience 2 - 4 years of experience in Talent Acquisition. Experience in BPO/ITES recruitment with exposure to mass hiring is preferred. Freshers with strong recruitment internships may be considered for entry-level positions. 
 Required Skills & Competencies Strong sourcing and screening skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Interviewing and candidate assessment capability. Stakeholder management and relationship-building skills. Negotiation and influencing skills. Good analytical and reporting skills. Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and ATS platforms. Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment. Strong organizational and multitasking abilities. 
 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Hiring Target Achievement (%) Time to Fill (TAT) Requisition Closure Rate Offer-to-Join Ratio Interview-to-Selection Ratio Recruiter Productivity (Hires per Month) Cost per Hire Candidate Experience Score Hiring Manager Satisfaction 30/60/90-Day Retention Metrics Ramp Fulfillment Percentage 
 Career Progression 
 Executive Talent Acquisition Senior Executive Talent Acquisition Talent Acquisition Specialist Assistant Manager Talent Acquisition Manager Talent Acquisition 
 Ideal for: BPO/ITES environments handling high-volume hiring, ramp-up projects, domestic and international customer support programs, technical support hiring, non-voice operations, and strategic workforce expansion.

title: Hr Executive And Recruiter
description:
Job Overview We are looking for a responsible, proactive, and organised HR Executive to manage day-to-day human resource activities and support the organisation's HR operations. The candidate will be responsible for recruitment, employee coordination, onboarding, attendance and leave management, employee engagement, HR documentation, and policy implementation. The ideal candidate should have good communication and interpersonal skills, the ability to handle multiple HR responsibilities, and a strong understanding of basic HR processes. Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment and Talent Acquisition Manage end-to-end recruitment activities for various positions within the organisation. Understand hiring requirements from respective departments and prepare job descriptions. Post job openings across relevant recruitment platforms. Source, screen, and shortlist suitable candidates through job portals, LinkedIn, referrals, and other channels. Conduct initial HR screening and coordinate interviews with hiring managers. Follow up with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Manage offer communication, candidate documentation, and joining formalities. 2. Employee Onboarding and Documentation Manage joining formalities and onboarding processes for new employees. Collect and verify employee documents and maintain employee records. Prepare and maintain appointment letters, offer letters, employment agreements, and other HR documents. Conduct HR induction and communicate company policies and procedures to new employees. Maintain accurate and updated employee databases. 3. Attendance, Leave and Employee Records Monitor daily employee attendance and maintain attendance records. Manage leave requests, approvals, and leave balances in accordance with company policies. Track employee working hours, late arrivals, absenteeism, and attendance-related issues. Maintain accurate records for payroll processing and monthly attendance reports. Coordinate with management regarding attendance discrepancies and leave-related matters. 4. Employee Relations and HR Operations Act as the primary point of contact for employees regarding HR-related queries. Address employee concerns, workplace issues, and grievances professionally. Maintain effective communication between employees and management. Monitor employee discipline, workplace conduct, and adherence to company policies. Coordinate employee engagement activities and initiatives. Support employee performance review and feedback processes. 5. HR Policies and Compliance Communicate and implement HR policies, procedures, and organisational guidelines. Ensure employees are aware of company rules, responsibilities, and workplace expectations. Maintain HR documentation related to employee performance, warnings, leave, and disciplinary matters. Support HR compliance and statutory documentation as applicable. Ensure proper maintenance and confidentiality of employee information. 6. Employee Exit and Separation Process Coordinate employee resignation and exit formalities. Conduct or coordinate exit interviews and collect employee feedback. Manage notice-period tracking and employee handover processes. Coordinate the preparation of relieving letters, experience letters, and other separation documents. Maintain employee separation records. 7. HR Reporting and Administration Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly HR reports as required by management. Maintain recruitment trackers, employee databases, attendance records, and HR documentation. Monitor hiring progress, employee joining status, attrition, and other HR metrics. Coordinate with management and department heads to ensure smooth HR operations. Handle other HR and administrative responsibilities assigned by management. Required Skills and Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field. Minimum 1 year of experience in HR operations or a similar HR role. Basic understanding of recruitment, onboarding, attendance management, and employee relations. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong interpersonal, coordination, and problem-solving abilities. Proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, MS Office, and email communication. Ability to maintain confidential employee information and HR records. Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple responsibilities. A proactive, responsible, and employee-focused approach. Key Expectations The HR Executive will be responsible for ensuring smooth day-to-day HR operations, maintaining employee records, supporting recruitment activities, addressing employee concerns, and implementing company policies. The candidate should be capable of independently handling routine HR responsibilities while coordinating effectively with management and employees.

 Joining: Immediate / Early Joiners Preferred About Angel Health Centre Angel Health Centre is a private, doctor-led longevity and aesthetics practice located at Nariman Point, Mumbai. We are building a premium healthcare organisation focused on personalised care, longevity, aesthetics, diagnostics and an exceptional client experience. As the organisation grows, we are looking for an experienced and highly hands-on HR Manager who can build a strong team, create effective people processes and develop a culture of accountability, professionalism and service excellence. The Role The HR Manager will take ownership of the complete employee lifecycle at Angel Health Centre — from identifying and recruiting the right talent to onboarding, performance management, training, engagement, retention and exit management. This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys building an organisation rather than simply administering an established HR function. The individual will work closely with the management and doctors to ensure that Angel attracts, develops and retains high-quality people who reflect the standards of a premium healthcare organisation. Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment & Talent Acquisition Own end-to-end recruitment across clinical, operations, front office, sales, marketing and management roles. Screen CVs and conduct first-level interviews. Coordinate management and technical interview rounds. Conduct reference and background checks. Manage salary negotiations and offer rollouts. Build and maintain an active talent pipeline for critical positions. Reduce recruitment turnaround time and improve quality of hires. 2. Onboarding & Induction Design and manage a structured onboarding process for every new employee. Ensure documentation, policies, systems access and joining formalities are completed. Conduct orientation around Angel's culture, standards and expectations. Coordinate department-specific training. Establish 30-, 60- and 90-day review processes for new employees. Ensure new employees are integrated effectively into the organisation. 3. Performance Management Help management establish clear KRAs and KPIs for every role. Implement monthly and quarterly performance reviews. Track employee performance against defined expectations. Work with department heads to identify performance gaps. Create Performance Improvement Plans where required. Develop a transparent appraisal and increment framework. Build a performance-oriented culture with clear accountability. 4. Maintain training calendars and employee development records. 5. Employee Engagement & Culture Build a professional, positive and high-performance work culture. Recognise and reward high-performing employees. Develop initiatives to improve employee motivation and retention. 6. Coordinate monthly payroll inputs with accounts/payroll partners. Maintain salary, incentive and employee documentation. Resolve employee payroll and attendance queries. Create employee handbooks, workplace policies and HR SOPs. Ensure employees understand and acknowledge organisational policies. Maintain confidentiality of employee and management information. Support management in disciplinary matters and grievance handling. Coordinate applicable statutory and employment-related HR compliance with relevant professional advisers. 8. Employee Retention & Exit Management Monitor employee turnover and identify reasons for attrition. Conduct structured stay interviews and exit interviews. Recommend retention initiatives for key employees. Manage resignation, notice period and handover processes. Ensure proper clearance and exit documentation. 9. Management Reporting The HR Manager will maintain a simple monthly HR dashboard covering: Total headcount Open positions Time taken to hire Offer-to-joining ratio Employee turnover Attendance and absenteeism Probation status Employee performance Training completed Employee grievances Upcoming manpower requirements Who We Are Looking For The ideal candidate should have: 5–8 years of progressive HR experience. description:
Company: Extrieve Technologies Pvt. Ltd. Department: Solutions Consulting Location: Mumbai Experience: 3 5 Years Employment Type: Full-Time Work Mode: Hybrid (Remote + Shared Workspace / Client Visits) 
 
 Job Summary 
 We are looking for a technically sound and client-oriented professional to handle pre-sales activities, software demonstrations, client interactions and software implementation. The individual will work closely with prospective and existing clients to understand their business requirements, present Extrieve s software solutions, conduct product demonstrations and support the implementation process. The role will also involve customer training, application support, and coordination with internal technical teams to ensure smooth project execution. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Interact with prospective and existing clients to understand their business requirements and expectations. Conduct client meetings, product demonstrations, and presentations. Explain Extrieve s software products, features and business benefits to customers. Support the sales team in pre-sales activities, client discussions, and follow-ups. Assist in understanding client requirements and suggesting suitable software solutions. Coordinate software installation, configuration, and implementation activities. Provide product training and guidance to clients and end users. Handle basic application-related queries and coordinate with technical teams for issue resolution. Monitor implementation of progress and ensure timely completion of activities. Prepare basic presentations, proposals, requirement documents, and implementation updates. Coordinate with internal Sales, Product, Development and Delivery teams. Travel to client locations for meetings, demonstrations, training and implementation activities whenever required. 
 
 Required Skills Competencies 
 Good understanding of software products, IT solutions, and software implementation. Experience in conducting product demonstrations and client presentations. Basic technical knowledge of software applications, installation, configuration, and troubleshooting. Good communication, presentation, and client-handling skills. Ability to understand business requirements and explain technical solutions in a simple language. Knowledge of MS Office, PowerPoint, Excel, and basic documentation tools. Good coordination, follow-up, and problem-solving abilities. Ability to independently manage client interactions and implementation activities. Willingness to travel for client meetings and customer support. 
 
 Educational Qualification 
 B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, IT or related disciplines preferred. BCA, MCA, B.Sc. IT or other relevant technical qualifications can also be considered. An MBA in IT, Marketing, or Business Management will be an added advantage. 
 
 Experience 
 3 5 years of relevant experience in Pre-Sales, Software Implementation, Technical Consulting, or Application Support. Prior experience working with IT companies, software product companies or technology solution providers will be preferred. Experience in handling client meetings, conducting product demonstrations, and supporting software implementation is desirable. Exposure to enterprise software solutions, document management systems, or workflow automation will be an added advantage. 
 
 Reporting Working Structure 
 The individual will report to the concerned Department Head / Management. Will work closely with the Sales, Product, Development and Delivery teams. The role will follow a hybrid working arrangement, with remote work and periodic visits to a shared workspace in Mumbai for team discussions, coordination and planning. Client visits will be required depending on business and implementation requirements.

title: Human Resources (HR) Executive
description:
Company: Radiant Minds Education Ltd
 Job Title: Human Resources (HR) Executive
 Department: Human Resources & Administration
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Work Location: Remote / Work from Home
 Working Days: Monday to Saturday 
 Working Hours: 9 hours per day, aligned with UK working hours (GMT/BST)
 Salary: Competitive, based on qualifications and experience 
 About Radiant Minds Education Radiant Minds Education Ltd is a UK-based education and training organisation specialising in Early Years Education, Childcare, Health and Social Care qualifications, and professional development. We are committed to delivering high-quality education and training while maintaining professional standards across our training and childcare operations. 
 We are looking for a highly organised, proactive and experienced Human Resources (HR) Executive to manage recruitment, employee relations, HR administration, staff performance monitoring and compliance with UK employment requirements. 
 The successful candidate will work closely with management to ensure efficient HR operations, effective workforce management and a positive working environment. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Recruitment and Talent Acquisition Manage the complete recruitment process, from identifying staffing requirements to onboarding successful candidates. Prepare and publish job advertisements on recruitment platforms, including Indeed, LinkedIn and other relevant websites. Screen CVs, shortlist candidates and conduct initial HR interviews. Coordinate interviews with departmental managers and directors. Conduct reference checks and coordinate appropriate background verification. Prepare offer letters, employment contracts and onboarding documentation. Maintain an organised recruitment database and candidate tracking system. Recruit suitable professionals for roles including academic writers, assessors, tutors, administrators, nursery practitioners and other operational positions. 
 2. Employee Onboarding and HR Administration Coordinate the onboarding process for new employees. Collect and verify employee documentation, including identification, qualifications and employment records. Maintain accurate employee files and confidential HR records. Prepare employment letters, contracts, amendments and other HR correspondence. Maintain employee attendance, leave and absence records. Ensure new employees receive relevant policies, procedures and induction information. Manage employee exit procedures, including resignation documentation, exit interviews and final clearance. 
 3. Attendance, Leave and Workforce Management Monitor daily employee attendance, punctuality and working hours. Maintain accurate records of annual leave, sickness absence and other authorised absences. Coordinate leave requests and approvals with management. Monitor adherence to agreed working schedules and UK business hours. Identify attendance concerns and report them to management. Support workforce scheduling and staff availability planning. Prepare regular attendance and absence reports. 
 4. Employee Relations and Performance Management Act as the first point of contact for routine employee HR queries. Support management in maintaining a professional and positive working environment. Coordinate employee performance reviews, probation meetings and appraisals. Monitor employee performance against agreed responsibilities and targets. Assist with resolving workplace concerns and employee grievances. Support disciplinary and grievance procedures in accordance with company policies and applicable employment law. Prepare meeting invitations, minutes, outcome letters and follow-up documentation. Maintain professional communication and confidentiality throughout employee relations processes. 
 5. HR Policies and UK Employment Compliance Assist in developing, reviewing and implementing company HR policies and procedures. Maintain awareness of relevant UK employment legislation and workplace requirements. Support compliance with working time, annual leave, sickness absence and employee rights requirements. Ensure employee information is handled securely and in accordance with UK GDPR and applicable data protection requirements. Coordinate right-to-work checks and relevant pre-employment checks. Support safer recruitment procedures, including appropriate DBS checks for roles involving children or vulnerable individuals. Maintain accurate records for internal reviews, inspections and compliance checks. Escalate complex employment law or regulatory matters to management or qualified advisers. 
 6. Training and Employee Development Identify employee training needs in collaboration with management. Coordinate induction, mandatory training and professional development activities. Maintain employee training records and monitor renewal dates. Track completion of relevant safeguarding, health and safety, first aid and other mandatory training. Support employee development plans and performance improvement initiatives. Coordinate training sessions and maintain relevant attendance records. 
 8. Communication and Management Support Communicate professionally with employees, applicants, management and external stakeholders. Draft formal HR emails, notices, letters and internal announcements. Coordinate HR meetings and maintain accurate meeting records. Follow up on outstanding employee documentation and management instructions. Support management with day-to-day administrative and operational HR requirements. Maintain effective communication with UK-based teams while working remotely. 
 Essential Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management or a related discipline. Minimum 2 years of relevant HR or recruitment experience. Strong understanding of recruitment, onboarding and HR administration. Knowledge of UK employment practices and HR procedures. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Experience preparing professional HR correspondence and documentation. Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook and Google Workspace. Strong organisational, administrative and time-management skills. Ability to handle sensitive employee information confidentially. Ability to work independently and manage multiple responsibilities. Availability to work 9 hours per day aligned with UK working hours. 
 Desirable Qualifications and Experience CIPD qualification or equivalent HR certification. Previous HR experience with a UK-based organisation. Experience recruiting for the education, childcare or training sectors. Knowledge of safer recruitment, safeguarding and DBS requirements. Familiarity with UK employment contracts, disciplinary procedures and grievance management. Experience working with remote or international teams. Experience using HR management systems, recruitment platforms and employee databases. 
 Key Skills and Competencies Strong recruitment and interviewing skills. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills. Attention to detail and accuracy. Problem-solving and decision-making abilities. Professionalism and confidentiality. Strong organisational and multitasking abilities. Ability to manage deadlines and competing priorities. Proactive approach to employee support and HR operations. Ability to work effectively with senior management. Strong understanding of workplace professionalism and employee relations. 
 Working Days and Hours Working Days: Monday to Friday
 Working Hours: 9 hours per day
 Time Zone: UK working hours (GMT/BST, as applicable)
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Work Arrangement: Remote / Work from Home Candidates must be available during the agreed UK working schedule to communicate with management, conduct interviews, coordinate recruitment activities and manage daily HR operations. 

 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The HR Executive's performance will be evaluated against: Recruitment Efficiency: Timely sourcing, screening and hiring of suitable candidates. Employee Documentation: Accurate and complete employee records. Attendance Management: Effective monitoring of attendance, leave and punctuality. title: Assistant Manager  Human Resources
description:
Assistant Manager Human Resources Location: Selakaraichal Road, Appanaickenpatti, Sulur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu Department: Human Resources & Administration Employment Type: Full-Time Role Summary We are seeking a detail-oriented, proactive Assistant Manager HR with strong hands-on experience in end-to-end payroll processing, statutory compliance, industrial relations (IR), and contract labor management in a manufacturing/factory environment. The role requires solid working knowledge of ESI, PF, and factory/pollution licensing requirements, as well as effective coordination with contract labor vendors and local authorities around Sulur/Coimbatore. Key Responsibilities 1. Payroll & Attendance Management Manage monthly payroll processing accurately and on time, including attendance/shift reconciliation, overtime, incentives, leave encashment, and full-and-final (F&F) settlements. Coordinate with finance and accounts teams for payroll disbursement, salary registers, deductions, and reconciliations. Maintain employee records, HRIS/attendance systems, and shift schedules in line with plant operations. 2. Statutory Compliance & Licensing (ESI, PF, Factory & Pollution) Ensure timely filing and remittance of EPF (PF) , ESIC (ESI) , Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund (LWF), Bonus, Gratuity, and other applicable central and Tamil Nadu state labour laws. Handle renewals, inspections, and documentation related to Factory Licenses (DISH / Factories Act), Pollution Control Board clearances (TNPCB), and other statutory/regulatory filings. Maintain statutory registers, notices, and audit-ready documentation for internal and external inspections. 3. Contract Labor & Vendor Coordination Coordinate day-to-day with contract labor vendors to meet manpower requisitions, deployment schedules, and skill requirements. Verify vendor compliance—including contractor licenses, PF/ESI challans, wage registers, and safety/onboarding formalities—before releasing vendor bills. Monitor contract workforce discipline, attendance, and grievance resolution on the shop floor. 4. Industrial Relations (IR) & Employee Engagement Support smooth industrial relations and maintain a harmonious, productive work environment on the shop floor. Assist in addressing worker grievances, disciplinary procedures, domestic inquiries (as required), and welfare initiatives. Partner with plant leadership and supervisors to communicate policies, safety rules, and operational updates effectively. Qualifications & Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; MBA / MSW / PGDM in HR or Labour Laws preferred. Experience: 4–8 years of HR experience in a manufacturing, engineering, or industrial plant setup, with proven hands-on ownership of payroll, statutory compliance, and contract labor management. Domain Knowledge: Strong practical command of PF, ESI, Factories Act, Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, wage/bonus laws, and familiarity with factory and pollution control licensing processes. Skills: Proficiency in MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, data reconciliation), payroll/HR software, strong negotiation and vendor management skills, and fluency in Tamil and English (Hindi is a plus for workforce communication).

The Talent Acquisition Executive will be responsible for managing the end-to-end recruitment process, from understanding manpower requirements and candidate sourcing to screening, selection, salary negotiations and offer acceptance. The role requires a proactive recruitment professional with strong sourcing capabilities, stakeholder management skills and a good understanding of the talent market. Prior experience in UAE Talent Acquisition is strongly preferred. 
 Primary Responsibilities Talent Acquisition A. Manpower Planning & Recruitment Coordination Understand hiring requirements and resource expectations from department heads and hiring managers. Coordinate with stakeholders to finalise job descriptions, candidate profiles and selection criteria. Manage approved manpower requisitions and recruitment priorities. Develop sourcing strategies to meet hiring requirements within agreed timelines. B. Talent Sourcing & Candidate Management Source candidates through LinkedIn, job portals, recruitment agencies, referrals and professional networks. Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring requirements. Conduct CV screening, preliminary assessments and candidate evaluations. Identify suitable candidates across various functions, including Sales, Insurance Operations, Underwriting, Finance, Technology and Support Services. Maintain an updated candidate database and recruitment tracker. C. Interview & Selection Management Coordinate and schedule interviews with hiring managers and business leaders. Conduct initial HR screening and assess candidate suitability. Obtain interview feedback and ensure timely communication with candidates. Coordinate subsequent interview rounds and manage the selection process. Facilitate salary discussions, expectation alignment and offer negotiations. D. Offer Management & Offer Acceptance Coordinate internal approvals for selected candidates. Prepare and issue offer letters in line with approved compensation and employment terms. Manage salary discussions, negotiations and candidate expectations. Follow up with selected candidates to secure offer acceptance. Coordinate collection of signed offer letters. Maintain offer status, acceptance records and expected joining details. Monitor offer dropouts and maintain effective communication with selected candidates until offer acceptance. 
 Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration or a related discipline. 3–5 years of experience in Talent Acquisition / Recruitment. Prior UAE Talent Acquisition experience is strongly preferred. Good understanding of UAE recruitment channels, sourcing strategies and local talent availability. Experience managing end-to-end recruitment across multiple functions. Hands-on experience with LinkedIn Recruiter, job portals and candidate databases. Experience recruiting within insurance, financial services or brokerage industries will be an added advantage. 
 Key Competencies Strong sourcing and talent identification capabilities. Excellent candidate screening and assessment skills. Effective stakeholder management and communication. Strong negotiation and offer management skills. Ability to manage multiple vacancies simultaneously. Strong follow-up, planning and execution capabilities. Results-oriented approach with a focus on timely vacancy closure. High levels of professionalism and confidentiality.

Key Skills: Talent acquisition,End To End Recruitment,Recruitment,Acquisition,End To End,End

title: Data Analyst For Performance Management
description:
Job Opportunity !!! 
 Job Title: Data Analyst Performance Management (Group HR)
 Organisation: JAIN Group
 Department: Human Resources Experience: Minimum 5+ years of relevant experience Reporting to: HR Head 
 Location: Jayanagar, Bengaluru 
 1. Role Purpose The Data Analyst will be an integral part of the Performance Management function within the Group HR Office, responsible for developing, implementing and maintaining data-driven performance management frameworks across the JAIN Group. 
 The role will involve creating performance measurement frameworks, defining metrics and indicators, establishing data collation and reporting mechanisms, and generating analytical reports to monitor organisational and employee performance across institutions. 
 2. Key Responsibilities A. Performance Management Framework & Metrics Support the design and development of performance management frameworks across the JAIN Group. Translate organisational, institutional and departmental objectives into measurable performance indicators. Assist in defining KRAs, KPIs, performance metrics and measurement parameters for teaching and non-teaching roles. Establish standardised data definitions, measurement criteria, reporting formats and performance evaluation mechanisms. Develop measurement matrices and tracking tools to monitor individual, departmental and institutional performance. Review existing metrics and recommend improvements to ensure relevance, consistency and measurable outcomes. 
 B. Performance Data Management & Consolidation Establish structured mechanisms for collecting, consolidating and validating performance-related data across institutions and campuses. Coordinate with HR teams, academic leadership, department heads and institutional stakeholders for timely data submission. Maintain centralised performance databases covering teaching and non-teaching employees. Ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency and confidentiality. Identify data gaps, inconsistencies and reporting deviations and facilitate necessary corrections. Maintain historical performance data to enable periodic and year-on-year comparisons. 
 C. Performance Analysis & Reporting Generate periodic performance reports, dashboards and analytical presentations for HR leadership and institutional management. Analyse performance trends across individuals, departments, campuses and institutions. Track achievement against defined KRAs, KPIs and institutional targets. Identify performance gaps, deviations and areas requiring management intervention. Prepare comparative performance reports and trend analyses. Provide data-backed insights to support performance review discussions and management decisions. 
 D. Teaching & Academic Performance Analytics Develop and maintain performance metrics relevant to teaching and academic employees. Support the analysis of academic performance indicators, teaching effectiveness parameters and other institution-defined measures. Consolidate and analyse data relating to faculty performance, academic responsibilities and defined deliverables. Develop reports to monitor performance against established academic and institutional expectations. Work with academic and HR stakeholders to ensure appropriate data capture and reporting mechanisms. 
 E. Non-Teaching & Administrative Performance Analytics Develop and maintain performance measurement and reporting mechanisms for non- teaching employees. Support the definition and tracking of KRAs and KPIs across administrative, operational, technical and support functions. Analyse individual and departmental performance against assigned responsibilities and measurable deliverables. Develop reports to monitor target achievement, productivity and role effectiveness. Support role-based performance analysis across different job families and institutional functions. 
 F. Performance Monitoring & Review Support Establish dashboards and tracking mechanisms for periodic performance reviews. Monitor completion of performance appraisal cycles and submission of review data. Generate reports on performance ratings, goal achievement, review completion and other relevant parameters. Identify trends in performance ratings and variations across departments and institutions. Provide analytical support for performance calibration and review discussions. Maintain performance records to support employee progression, development planning and organisational decisions. 
 G. Dashboard Development & Process Automation Develop interactive performance dashboards using Power BI or equivalent business intelligence tools. Automate data collation, consolidation and recurring reporting processes. Integrate data from HRMS, ERP systems, Excel-based trackers and other institutional platforms. Develop standardised templates and reporting tools for institutional HR teams. Continuously improve reporting processes to minimise manual intervention and improve turnaround time. 
 H. Technical Expertise & Analytical Capabilities Advanced proficiency in Excel, including complex formulas, Power Query, Power Pivot, data modelling and automation. Excellent hands-on expertise in Power BI, including advanced dashboard development, DAX, data modelling and interactive visualisations. Strong SQL skills for extracting, manipulating and analysing large datasets from multiple sources. Ability to design professional, interactive and management-ready dashboards. Expertise in developing comprehensive reports, analytical presentations, trend analysis and performance summaries. Ability to establish data structures, measurement matrices and reporting frameworks from the ground up. Experience in automating recurring reports and developing standardised reporting systems. Ability to independently convert raw data into meaningful insights and actionable management reports. 
 3. Essential Qualifications & Experience Graduate/Postgraduate qualification in Statistics, Mathematics, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Economics, Computer Science or a related discipline. Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in Data Analytics, Business Analytics, Performance Analytics or Management Information Systems with substantial analytical responsibilities. Demonstrated experience in developing analytical frameworks, performance metrics and reporting dashboards. Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Power Query, Pivot Tables, data modelling and advanced formulas. Strong hands-on experience in Power BI, including dashboard development, DAX and data visualisation. Working knowledge of SQL for data extraction, querying and manipulation. Experience in handling large datasets, data validation, consolidation and interpretation. Ability to generate management-level reports and translate data into actionable insights. 
 4. Preferred Experience Experience in Performance Management, HR Analytics, Workforce Analytics or Organisational Effectiveness. Experience in developing or implementing performance measurement frameworks, KRAs and KPIs. Exposure to both teaching and non-teaching workforce analytics, preferably in educational institutions or large multi-location organisations. Experience working with senior management, HR teams and multiple institutional stakeholders. Familiarity with HRMS, ERP and performance management systems. 
 5. Key Competencies Analytical thinking and structured problem-solving. Strong data interpretation and reporting capabilities. Ability to convert organisational objectives into measurable indicators. Strong dashboard development and data visualisation skills. Attention to detail and data accuracy. Stakeholder coordination and communication. Ability to manage multiple reporting cycles and timelines. Confidentiality and integrity in handling performance-related information. Ability to work independently and take ownership of analytical assignments. 
 6. Mandatory Candidate Screening Criteria Only candidates with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience and demonstrated practical expertise in the following areas will be considered: 1. Data analytics, performance analytics or business analytics. 2. Development of dashboards and performance measurement reports. 3. Advanced Excel, Power BI and SQL. 4. Data consolidation, validation, interpretation and reporting. 5. Development or implementation of metrics, KPIs, measurement frameworks or analytical reporting systems. Candidates whose experience is restricted to data entry, routine MIS preparation, administrative reporting or general HR operations will not be considered. 
 7. Expected Deliverables Group-wide performance measurement and reporting framework. Standardised KRA and KPI measurement matrices. Centralised teaching and non-teaching performance database. Institutional, departmental and employee performance dashboards. Periodic performance analysis and management reports. Performance review tracking and monitoring reports. Data-backed insights to support performance improvement and management decisions. Automated and standardised performance data reporting processes. 
 Industry Preference: Education / Corporate / HR Analytics (preferred)

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Senior Business Development Executive / BDM (Presales) Full-Time 35 Years Experience International Markets 
 About the Role We are looking for a high-performing, quota-carrying Senior Business Development Executive / Business Development Manager (Presales) with 3–5 years of proven experience in selling IT and Software Development Services to international clients. 
 The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing the complete client acquisition lifecycle, from identifying and engaging potential clients to conducting consultative presales discussions, preparing commercial proposals, negotiating contracts, and closing high-value deals. You will play a key role in building a predictable sales pipeline, developing international business opportunities, and driving revenue growth across global markets. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. International Business Development & Client Acquisition Identify, prospect, qualify, and acquire B2B clients across North America, UK/Europe, the Middle East (UAE/GCC), and APAC. Promote services including Custom Software Development, Web and Mobile Applications, SaaS Engineering, Cloud Solutions, and AI Development. Build and maintain strong relationships with international founders, CTOs, and technology decision-makers. 2. Outbound Sales & Lead Generation Develop and execute structured outbound sales campaigns. Leverage LinkedIn Sales Navigator, personalized cold emails, cold calling, and B2B platforms such as Clutch, Upwork, and GoodFirms. Build targeted prospect lists and maintain consistent engagement with potential clients. Develop scalable and predictable lead-generation strategies. 3. Consultative Presales & Solution Scoping Conduct discovery calls with international founders, CTOs, and VPs of Engineering. Understand business requirements and translate them into technical project scopes. Coordinate with engineering teams to define project deliverables, timelines, resource requirements, and budgets. Present appropriate technical and commercial solutions to prospective clients. 4. Proposals, SOWs & RFP Management Prepare and manage business proposals, capability presentations, effort estimations, and Statements of Work (SOW). Collaborate with engineering leads and solution architects to develop accurate project estimates. Handle RFP/RFI responses and ensure proposals align with client expectations. 5. Commercial Negotiation & Deal Closure Recommend suitable engagement models:
 Fixed-Cost Projects Time & Material (T&M) Dedicated Development Teams Staff Augmentation Handle pricing discussions, commercial objections, and contract negotiations. Negotiate MSAs and close high-value software development contracts. 6. Pipeline Management & Revenue Forecasting Maintain accurate sales records and pipeline visibility using HubSpot, Zoho, Pipedrive, or similar CRM platforms. Track lead conversion rates, deal stages, sales performance, and revenue targets. Prepare accurate monthly and quarterly sales forecasts. Consistently work toward achieving assigned sales quotas. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications Experience: 3–5 years of hands-on experience in IT Services Sales, Software Development Sales, or Digital Agency Business Development. Proven Sales Performance: Demonstrated ability to achieve or exceed sales targets and close international software development deals. International Market Exposure: Experience handling clients from at least one major international market, including the USA, UK/Europe, UAE/Middle East, or Australia. Technical Presales Knowledge: Good understanding of web and mobile technologies, software architecture fundamentals, SDLC, MVP development, and project estimation. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills, presentation abilities, and cross-cultural business communication. Negotiation Skills: Strong commercial understanding, objection handling, pricing negotiation, and deal-closing capabilities. Sales Tools: Hands-on experience with:
 LinkedIn Sales Navigator Apollo.io / ZoomInfo / Lusha Cold Email Automation Tools HubSpot / Zoho / Pipedrive CRM Clutch, Upwork, and GoodFirms 
 Preferred Qualifications Experience selling high-value engagements involving AI/ML solutions, SaaS product development, and end-to-end software engineering. Experience acquiring long-term dedicated engineering teams or offshore development engagements. Existing professional network of international startup founders, CTOs, technology executives, or agency partners. Experience working with offshore development teams and international outsourcing business models. 
 Key Performance Expectations (KPIs) Consistent achievement of monthly and quarterly revenue targets. Number of qualified international leads generated. Discovery calls and client meetings conducted. Proposal-to-deal conversion rate. Number and value of contracts successfully closed. Growth of the international sales pipeline. Client acquisition and revenue contribution. 
 Ideal Candidate Profile We are looking for someone who is not just a lead generator but a complete sales professional who can independently identify opportunities, understand client requirements, position technology solutions, negotiate commercials, and close international software development deals. 
 The candidate should be highly driven, commercially focused, confident in dealing with senior technology executives, and motivated by performance-based growth and uncapped earning potential.

Key Skills: Revenue,Business development,IT services,Lead generation,CRM,Cold,Proposal writing,Cloud Applications
